trigger.title: Brake pad note
trigger.details: From https://spokeclinic.test/guides/pads, make a new note 'Brake pad checks' with the replacement threshold and the cleaning warning.

fixtures.https://spokeclinic.test/guides/pads:
Pad checks

Replace pads when friction material is thinner than 1 mm.

Keep oil and grease away from pads and rotors.

Wear clean gloves when handling replacement pads.

args.title: Brake pad checks
args.text: Replace pads when friction material is thinner than 1 mm. Keep oil and grease away from pads and rotors.

args.summary: Recorded the 1 mm threshold and oil/grease warning.
